newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major denies rift with minister over EMU.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major denies rift with minister over EMU.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major on Friday denied that his agriculture minister Angela Browning was out of step with government policy on a single European currency.

Major said he had not seen the details of Browning's newsletter which the Labour Party said stated her opposition to the single currency. "But she says her views are entirely compatible with the government and the manifesto," Major said.

Major said Browning would not countenance surrender of sovereignty on tax and spending. "Neither would I," he said. But newspapers reported that the issue discussed in Browning's newsletter was central bank reserves, not fiscal policy.

Labour's foreign affairs spokesman Robin Cook said Major should tell Browning to withdraw her manifesto or dismiss her from the government. In a message to the Eurosceptic members of his party Major said there was no chance of him withdrawing from negotiations over EMU.
"I want the maximum leverage whether I decide to enter or decide to stay out," he said.
